migrationNotes: Third HHH Core Case release, produced against the released Core Case 02 baseline ca21e3eda282c1d46b53abe7966e9e0176db96bc and the approved Blueprint.

Owner-approved printable baseline: 384bd5790bcc760b6b692c4a872451073e1c0dbb. The owner reviewed that byte set on screen and printed it at 100% / Actual Size. Release conversion changed no printable source: content.html, presentation.css and layout-overrides.json are byte-identical to that commit, and only task-registry.js moved, to carry the lifecycle stamp, which renders nothing. All 34 pages were re-rendered in colour and grayscale at both trees and all 68 page images are byte-identical.

Certified release-source commit: aba9768fd00d7cad67a20a167ac90491e865987b. The released task-registry.js bytes first exist there, because the lifecycle stamp is created by release conversion, so the three commit pins identify that commit rather than the owner printable baseline. The two are recorded separately and deliberately.

No post-review art-direction commits exist for this case. Case 02 acquired three owner-directed art commits after independent review and before approval; Case 03 was refined before the review candidate instead, which is why the reviewed commit and the approved commit are the same commit.

Frozen game-source baseline: d9fc16baf272cb543c29cbd0c06ec85efad60be8. Dossier cards A, B and C quote or paraphrase Level 3 at that commit. The Phase 1 audit baseline remains 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056.

Game dependency HHH-GAME-C1L3-001 is RESOLVED_VERIFIED at d9fc16b, verified by direct byte inspection of the level rather than from the tracker summary. All three audited universals are gone from the game's authoritative framing. The three of them plus three single-cause formulations are recorded in task-registry.js under causationBoundary.prohibitedClaims, and a browser assertion keeps every phrase out of every role.
Runtime case identity: C1 L3, County Cork, the south of Ireland, 1845. instructionalType CORE_CASE.

Nine tasks carry the Core Case spine, and the case's organising idea is sufficiency rather than chronology or scale: a documented biological trigger is available, is correct, and does not explain the death toll. Task 4 settles that with a real historical control - the same organism took almost 90% of Belgium's 1845 potato harvest against about 30% of Ireland's, and Belgian famine mortality ran 30-40% above normal against about three times normal in Ireland.

Canonical CER is deliberately not used. The culminating product must hold several conditions together and state what it cannot settle, and a frame built for defending one position would push toward the single-cause account the case exists to prevent. Teacher page 5 states the reasoning architecture for classroom readers.

Causation boundary: the Family H5 causes map puts four separately evidenced conditions between the crop failure and the outcome at identical width with identical arrows, and states in print that every arrow means only contributed to and that nothing in the packet ranks them. Task 6 assesses interaction rather than enumeration. Task 7 marks the biological single cause N, the political single cause N, and the export counterfactual undecidable, carrying both published readings of the trade record.

Source model: ten canonical caseSources entries, including a real 1846 primary source - Nicholas Cummins's letter from Skibbereen, published in The Times on 24 December 1846 - placed beside written-for-the-game dialogue so Task 5 can make the difference assessable across five evidentiary statuses. No source/evidence-ledger.json was created; the registered package schema is closed and the evidence model lives where Cases 01 and 02 carry it.

Regression protection added with this case and retained by the release: registry-driven learner source-status parity against caseSources.evidentiaryStatus, a primary-source and eyewitness prohibition scoped to game-origin blocks only, load-bearing no-game fact availability in both learner editions, prohibited universals and single-cause formulations read from the task registry, comparison-bar geometry measured off the rendered figure, causes-map condition widths measured for equality with the no-ranking disclaimer required inside the figure, timeline strand tags and relief ordering, place-name presence with collision measurement, keyed claim marks checked against the registry, citation guards bound to the reference entries, an answer-disclosure guard on Accessible Task 7, and semantic bounded-extent guards driven by observationExtent on the archive-scenes source.

Fourteen negative controls were run against the assertion set and all fourteen were caught. Two failed to catch on their first run and the tests, not the content, were strengthened: a Belgian-value control that matched the causes map's unrelated 90%, and a soup-kitchen control that matched the unrelated cottier three-million figure.
This release claims no SSS legacy exemption. It is a full current-contract release with frozen Student, Teacher and Answer Key DOM baselines.
